ask: muse mkae a draft so evryone gets a pick plz
sentence: Group members take turns picking from a shared list of options in a random snake order (1 2 3, then 3 2 1) until the pick limit is reached or the list is empty.
use_when: A group needs to split up a list of options fairly, with everyone getting turns to pick
Choosing activities, spots, or tasks for a trip or event one pick at a time
People want a random turn order that reverses each round so no one always goes first
Dividing a small set of items among chat members
dont_use_when: The group just wants to vote on one option or find the most popular choice (use a poll)
Picks need ranking, bidding, or points instead of turns
Only one person is deciding, or the list has more than 8 items
